question_for_user: Will you run `sudo scripts/night/install_cache_trim.sh` once, after which I rerun the CUDA dry run's phase B? Phase B was blocked because Windows free memory was 7.2 to 9.8 GB: the WSL VM holds about 40 GB of Linux page cache, and autoMemoryReclaim never fires while WSL is busy. WSL 2.7.11 requires user CPU below 0.5% of all cores for 10 minutes; the agent sessions measured 5,978 against a threshold of 360 ticks per 30 s. The service caps the page cache at 8 GiB via the root cgroup's memory.reclaim and compacts memory so Windows gets the pages back. It also protects the training guard's 8 GiB floor during real nights. Recommended: yes, and raise the GPU start limit from 2,048 to 6,144 MiB, since the Windows desktop alone holds 5.1 to 5.3 GB.
